kri_description: In UiTM, compliance with legal, regulatory, policy, and contractual frameworks is fundamental to safeguarding institutional integrity, governance credibility and public accountability. Non-compliance with soft laws, including internal policies, circulars, codes of conduct, governance guidelines, and professional standards, may weaken governance practices, compromise operational effectiveness, erode stakeholder confidence and ultimately expose the University to legal, regulatory, and reputational risks. More significantly, breaches of hard laws, statutory requirements, governmental directives, and binding contractual obligations may expose UiTM to legal proceedings, financial liabilities, regulatory sanctions, contractual disputes, reputational damage and potential loss of institutional rights or privileges. Given the increasingly complex regulatory and governance landscape applicable to public universities, it is imperative for UiTM to cultivate a proactive, systematic and institution-wide culture of compliance to ensure adherence to applicable laws, policies, and contractual commitments, while sustaining UiTM’s standing as a trusted, accountable and well-governed institution.

Non-compliance with soft laws, including internal policies, circulars, codes of conduct, governance guidelines, and professional standards, may weaken governance practices, compromise operational effectiveness, erode stakeholder confidence and ultimately expose the University to legal, regulatory, and reputational risks. More significantly, breaches of hard laws, statutory requirements, governmental directives, and binding contractual obligations may expose UiTM to legal proceedings, financial liabilities, regulatory sanctions, contractual disputes, reputational damage and potential loss of institutional rights or privileges. Given the increasingly complex regulatory and governance landscape applicable to public universities, it is imperative for UiTM to cultivate a proactive, systematic and institution-wide culture of compliance to ensure adherence to applicable laws, policies, and contractual commitments, while sustaining UiTM’s standing as a trusted, accountable and well-governed institution.

When operations are not carried out according to established procedures, it increases the risk of inefficiencies, errors, and inconsistent outcomes that can impact service delivery and institutional performance.
